description: This file contains the implementation of the ShoppingCartFacade interface, providing methods for managing shopping cart operations such as adding, updating, deleting items, and retrieving cart data within an e-commerce system. It leverages various services and models to perform business logic related to shopping cart management.

classes.name: ShoppingCartFacadeImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ShoppingCartFacade providing core business logic for managing shopping carts, including adding, updating, deleting items, and retrieving cart data.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes a shopping cart by its ID and store.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes a shopping cart by its code and store.

methods.name: addItemsToShoppingCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart, creating or updating the cart as necessary, and returning the updated cart data.

methods.name: createCartModel
methods.description: Creates a new shopping cart model instance, associating it with a customer and store.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart data by customer and store, or by shopping cart ID.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Populates ShoppingCartData object from ShoppingCart model.

methods.name: removeCartItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the shopping cart based on item ID and cart code.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific item in the shopping cart.

methods.name: updateCartItems
methods.description: Updates multiple items in the shopping cart based on provided ShoppingCartItem list.

methods.name: getCartModel
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart model by code and store.

methods.name: getShoppingCartModel
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart model by customer and store.
